paper.title: A bill for an act to require work or training for adults on Medicaid and to require work or training for adults who receive cash assistance.
paper.purpose: a work requirement for Medicaid coverage and ending the work requirement for cash assistance

sections.text: Section 1. Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled That an adult shall show work or training hours to keep Medicaid coverage.
Section 2. And be it further enacted, That the law now in force on a work requirement for cash assistance is repealed.

paper.effective: This Act takes effect on January 22, 2025.

paper.title: A bill for an act to require work or training for adults on Medicaid and to set the rate of the local income tax.
paper.purpose: ending the work requirement for Medicaid coverage and a lower local income tax rate

sections.text: Section 1. Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled That the law now in force on a work requirement for Medicaid is repealed.
Section 2. And be it further enacted, That the local income tax rate shall be lowered from 36 percent to 36 percent, amending S. 2.

paper.effective: This Act takes effect on January 23, 2025.
